source_name: SEOnet – Ljubljana Stock Exchange regulated-information system
why_relevant: Central Slovenian repository of issuers' regulated announcements (ZTFI-1 art. 155/156). Any listed bank's board appointment/resignation lands here; single feed covering multiple actors.

source_name: OTP banka d.d. (Slovenia) – corporate site / OTP group page
why_relevant: Successor entity of Nova KBM + SKB merger (second-largest Slovenian bank). Its own pages document the merged organisation, management-board composition and post-merger reorganisation.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – Obvestila (announcements)
why_relevant: Fastest-growing Slovenian savings bank; publishes explicit board and supervisory-board appointment notices and shareholder notices on a dedicated announcements index.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – Vizitka in vodstvo (leadership roster)
why_relevant: Authoritative current-state roster of management board; diffing it detects departures that are never announced in a press release.

source_name: Delavska hranilnica – Letna poročila (annual reports PDF)
why_relevant: Corporate governance chapter lists every board/supervisory-board change during the year with dates — a reliable backfill and reconciliation source for missed announcements.

source_name: Gorenjska banka d.d., Kranj – corporate news / about
why_relevant: AIK-owned bank that publishes standalone management-board appointment notices on its own site (e.g. new management-board member for retail).

source_name: Addiko Bank Slovenija – Sporočila za javnost / medijsko središče
why_relevant: Slovenian arm of listed Addiko Group; local media centre carries local management and reorganisation notices, complementing group-level ad-hoc disclosures.

source_name: SID banka – Novice (news)
why_relevant: State-owned promotional/development bank; publishes individual news items when management- or supervisory-board members take office, including Bank of Slovenia licence confirmation and start dates.

source_name: SID banka – Organi upravljanja / Vodstvo / Organizacijska struktura
why_relevant: Explicit governance-body roster plus a published organisational structure with contacts — directly usable for org-change detection, not just leadership names.

source_name: Hranilnica LON d.d., Kranj – Informacije za delničarje in vlagatelje
why_relevant: Small savings bank with an active shareholder-notice page; publishes AGM convocations and supervisory-board appointments including conditional appointments pending Bank of Slovenia approval.

source_name: Primorska hranilnica Vipava d.d. – corporate site
why_relevant: Smallest of the three Slovenian savings banks; corporate site is the only first-party channel for its board composition and any governance change.

source_name: Banka Intesa Sanpaolo d.d. (SI) – Informacije za medije
why_relevant: Former Banka Koper; its media-information page is the first-party channel for local management changes and organisational news of the Intesa subsidiary.

source_name: SDH – Slovenski državni holding, Aktualno (news)
why_relevant: State asset manager that nominates and appoints supervisory-board members of state-owned banks (NLB stake, SID banka context); its news and accreditation/nomination pages pre-announce governance changes before the banks do.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Sporočila za javnost in novice
why_relevant: Banking association aggregating sector news; its governing bodies are staffed by bank CEOs, so its news and body composition indirectly reveal who currently leads each member bank.

source_name: Društvo Mali delničarji Slovenije (MDS) – bank shareholder/AGM tracker
why_relevant: Minority-shareholder association that tracks AGMs of essentially every Slovenian bank and savings bank and reports on supervisory-board elections, disputes and contested appointments that banks downplay.

source_name: Hrvatska narodna banka / host-regulator approval notices for Addiko board appointments
why_relevant: Illustrates the regulator-approval pattern for Addiko-group board appointments; useful as a cross-border corroboration channel and as a template for finding equivalent Bank of Slovenia fit-and-proper decisions.

source_name: Gorenjska banka – Dodatna razkritja (corporate governance disclosure PDF)
why_relevant: Pillar-3 style governance disclosure describing internal and corporate governance arrangements, board committees and organisational setup — the most structural org-change evidence a bank publishes voluntarily.

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. — Zaposlitev (careers page)
why_relevant: Bankart is the Slovenian card/payment processing centre owned by the banks; each individual job ad (e.g. 'Poslovni analitik za razvoj IT storitev na podrocju procesiranja sodobnih placilnih instrumentov', 'Linux sistemski inzenir', 'Razvojni inzenir analitik') names the concrete payments workstream being staffed, which is the closest public proxy for which bank-facing processing projects are ramping.

source_name: Halcom d.d. — Zaposlitev
why_relevant: Halcom (Trzaska cesta 118, Ljubljana) has supplied e-banking and payment-system solutions to financial institutions since 1992; its own hiring and any leadership announcements indicate which bank e-banking/digital-signature projects are expanding.

source_name: Optius.com — employer profile pages (job aggregator, SI)
why_relevant: Slovenian job portal (operated by Moja zaposlitev d.o.o., Trzin) with per-employer landing pages — confirmed pages exist for Halcom d.d. and Comtrade d.o.o. It is a pointer that both aggregates vendor ads and reveals which supplier entities are actively hiring without visiting every vendor site.

source_name: MojeDelo.com — Slovenian job portal
why_relevant: Described in search results as holding the largest collection of job openings in Slovenia; the natural second aggregator alongside Optius for catching supplier-side IT/banking vacancies that never reach vendor websites.

source_name: Zavod RS za zaposlovanje (ESS) — Iskanje dela / PDM vacancy notifications
why_relevant: The national employment service publishes registered vacancies; Slovenian employers must notify vacancies via the PDM-1 form (SPOT), so ESS is the statutory floor of hiring visibility for supplier companies that do not advertise publicly.

source_name: Bizi.si — company profiles for SI banking-IT vendors
why_relevant: Commercial register mirror with headcount, address and activity code; confirmed entity pages exist for PAYTEN d.o.o. (Litostrojska cesta 44C, Ljubljana, SKD 62.200) and Comtrade programske resitve d.o.o. Headcount drift over time is a quantitative hiring signal that job ads miss.

source_name: CompanyWall.si — SI company profiles (Printec S.I., Kontron, Payten)
why_relevant: Second commercial mirror; the PRINTEC S.I. d.o.o. profile carries address (Vodovodna cesta 100, Ljubljana), activity (wholesale of ICT equipment) and an employee figure (~25.7), giving a baseline for detecting Printec SI headcount expansion. Confirmed profiles also exist for Kontron d.o.o. and Payten d.o.o.

source_name: Kontron SI d.o.o. — Zaposlitev (ex-S&T Slovenija / Iskratel successor)
why_relevant: Kontron SI d.o.o. was carved out in 2024 from Kontron d.o.o. (itself S&T Slovenija merged with Iskratel in 2022 as S&T Iskratel, renamed Kontron in July 2023) and is the successor integrator for the S&T/Iskratel enterprise-IT book, incl. bank infrastructure. HQ Ljubljana with units in Kranj, Celje, Maribor. Its careers page and 'O podjetju' page carry both hiring and management-change signals (Jure Fir replacing Sasa Berger, co-leading with Robert Kuzmic was reported in SI IT press).

source_name: Racunalniske novice — SI IT trade press (appointments & vendor partner pages)
why_relevant: Slovenian IT trade outlet that actually publishes vendor country-manager appointments ('Novi direktor Oracle Slovenija') and maintains per-vendor partner pages (e.g. Kontron). This is the local-language channel where an NCR Atleos / Diebold Nixdorf / Printec SI country-manager appointment would most plausibly surface first.

source_name: Revija Finance — Top IKT / IKT vertical (business daily, paywalled)
why_relevant: Slovenia's business daily runs a dedicated IKT vertical and a periodic 'Top IKT' supplement profiling IT suppliers; it is the main outlet for management changes and contract wins at SI IT vendors selling into banks. A public PDF of the 5 July 2024 'Revija Finance Top IKT' issue was found mirrored on a vendor site, showing the supplement exists and circulates.
